title: Late Fee Waiver Allowance on ComfortLease Equipment Leases
content:
**Allowance.** A late fee on a ComfortLease Equipment Leases agreement may be waived only while fewer than 1 waiver was granted in the preceding 12 months.

| Leased system | Late fee waivers allowed in any 12 months |
|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | 1 |
| ComfortLease Central Air | 1 |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | 1 |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | 1 |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | 1 |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | 1 |

## Questions answered

**What is counted?**
The late fee waiver credits on the same lease, posted in the rolling 12 calendar months that end on the day the waiver is being considered.

**What is the count compared with?**
The allowance of 1. A waiver is permitted only while the count is fewer than 1 — that is, while no late fee waiver has been granted on the lease in that window.

**Where does the count come from?**
From the lease's own billing history. A waiver appears there as a late fee waiver credit naming the late fee it waives, so the count is read from those records, whatever the lessee recalls.

**What does a waiver look like once granted?**
A late fee waiver credit on the lease, naming the specific late fee waived, which reduces what the lessee owes.

**Does a waiver on another lease of the same customer count?**
No. The count is of waivers on the lease that carries the late fee.

## Cases (hypothetical histories)

| Late fee waivers on the lease in the preceding 12 months | Fewer than 1? | May the late fee be waived? |
|---|---|---|
| None — the lease has never had a waiver | Yes | Yes |
| None — the only waiver was granted 14 months ago | Yes | Yes |
| One, granted 5 months ago | No | No |
| One, granted 11 months ago | No | No |
